reviewItem.question: Does "Operating Cilium in `--datapath-mode=lb-only` for plain Docker mode now requires to add an additional `--enable-k8s=false` to the command line, otherwise it is…" mean a change to cli-flag:cilium|name=--enable-k8s (now-required)?

proposed.statement: Running Cilium with --datapath-mode=lb-only in plain Docker mode now requires adding --enable-k8s=false, otherwise Kubernetes is assumed to be present.
